title: Research thread brief
description: The only input a research worker receives. No plan, no sibling dossier, no chat history: a worker that needs anything beyond this has been briefed badly.

thread_id.description: Matches the thread directory name. A path component: no separators, never . or ..

task.description: One or two self-contained sentences. Self-contained is the requirement, not the style: the worker has no other context.

must_cover.description: Checklist the worker answers against before it may stop.

avoid.description: Ground a sibling thread already covered. The director can populate this because it has read the other dossiers; the worker still receives only this brief, so isolation holds.

budget.description: The scheduler enforces minutes by killing the process; the worker honours cycles and max_sources itself.
